youtube.aciklama: Take how long seven people have had tinnitus: 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 40 years. The mean is 63 divided by 7, or 9 years; the median, the value in the middle when the values are sorted, is 4 years. A single outlier, 40 years, has pulled the mean up to 9, so the median is preferred for skewed distributions.
